summary: Persist a source-text-free execution receipt for every settled QA V3 input and retain the receipt with either the immutable result or a safe evaluation contract failure.
decision_refs: The active goal requires CIRP to manage advanced-model task, version, result, citation and review identity locally
A frozen selector and model profile do not by themselves prove which evidence rows, images and prompt contract were sent in each model decision
A compact hash receipt closes the audit gap without duplicating source text or adding semantic preprocessing
approval_evidence: The active goal explicitly requires an auditable advanced-model reference implementation with CRIP managing local inputs and results while minimizing unnecessary model content.
known_limitations: Receipts prove exact hashed input identity and size, not that the selected input was relevant or that the answer was correct.
Historical results and failures remain valid without a receipt and are not rewritten.
A receipt intentionally excludes source text, prompt content, rejected provider output and private reasoning.
No external or paid model request is made by this implementation task.
